title: FluoZin-3 and Zinc Measurement in CYT Samples
summary: This cluster is about the measurement of zinc in CYT samples using FluoZin-3. FluoZin-3 was dissolved in DMSO and Sigma Aldrich, and then spiked into CYT samples. The samples were measured for absorbance and total zinc. The results were published in the Journal of Biological Chemistry by Kreinbrink Alexia C. and Lindahl Paul A. is also associated with this publication.
